_about: Hand-kept lessons for the cockpit (P-591): date, lesson, what changed, source. Newest first. The tech lead adds one when a decision changes how we work.

learnings.lesson: Numbers the founder reads must come from script data, never from prose.
learnings.changed: One live cockpit fed by a script, refreshed hourly; every report opens with its link; a fresh reviewer checks it weekly.

learnings.lesson: "please dont use anything that is cheap and not gold class from public repo" (founder)
learnings.changed: Code, data feeds or packages from public repositories are used only when they meet the gold-class bar.

learnings.lesson: A date stays a forecast until it is measured.
learnings.changed: The build date (about 12-14 Jan) is shown as a forecast; the 19 Nov five-day count settles the line and the conversion.
